GAB.note: Programme is for young Gabonese, not civil servants; ANINF only may recruit top trainees.

facts.fact: ANINF and Cybastion launched the free Africa DigiEmpower digital and cybersecurity training programme for 1,000 young Gabonese on 27 January 2026, with three levels hosted at the ANINF Academy.

GAB.note: Training programme only; no government-run system is stated.
